faq.description: Answers to the questions that start a great getaway.

questions.title: What is an A-frame cabin?
questions.answer: It is a house with a distinctive triangular roof that reaches almost to the ground. Inside is a cosy space to unwind, with nature beyond the large windows. Each cabin has its own amenities, which you can find in its details.

questions.title: How do I choose a cabin for my group?
questions.answer: Enter your dates and group size. The catalog will show available cabins with enough space. Compare amenities, beds and house rules.

questions.title: Can I visit in winter?
questions.answer: A-frame cabins can be enjoyed in different seasons. For a winter trip, choose a cabin with heating and check the access road conditions and availability for your dates with the owner.

questions.title: Is this already a working booking service?
questions.answer: Choose dates on the cabin page and submit your request after signing in. Your booking is saved and awaits the host’s confirmation. Pay 5 KGS through Finik Pay from your booking details.

questions.title: What information does an owner need to provide?
questions.answer: A cabin name and description, exact address, nightly rate, guest capacity, amenities and photos. House rules and a contact number are also needed. These details help guests choose the right place.
